subject: CedarCloud SIG/CAIQ: key custody narrative + rotation sample request
messages:
From: Ethan Rogers <ethan@cedarcloud.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: CedarCloud Security Team <security@cedarcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CedarCloud SIG/CAIQ: request for key custody + rotation samples

Hi Neha —

Thanks for taking this. As part of our onboarding SIG/CAIQ review CedarCloud needs a short set of deliverables focused on encryption and key management to close the security questionnaire items (sections SC-2 / CRY-1). Specifically we need: 

- A short "key custody narrative" describing how Redwood manages master/KEK lifecycle (who holds keys, HSM boundaries, BYOK options).
- The HSM vendor attestation(s) that cover the firmware/SEAL attestation used for our tenant (we only need the attestation meta and date, not private keys).
- A rotation log export covering the past 12 months (rotation events, operator id, reason: routine/eviction), redacted for other customers. CSV is fine; if you can provide a truncated sample line-format that demonstrates the schema that will work.
- Clarification on ephemeral tenant keys and whether per-tenant KEKs are exported or wrapped (we need the wrap/unwrap flow for BYOK).

Can you confirm whether you can provide these items by Tue May 11? Also attaching our SIG worksheet for context. If you prefer a short call to align on redaction rules/format, I'm available most afternoons PST.

Attachments: cedarcloud_sig_questions.xlsx (worksheet)

Thanks,
Ethan Rogers
Security Manager — CedarCloud
security@cedarcloud.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Rogers <ethan@cedarcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CedarCloud SIG/CAIQ: request for key custody + rotation samples

Hi Ethan — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (ops) and Marissa (compliance) so we can coordinate artifacts and the redaction checklist.

High-level plan:
- We will provide the key custody narrative (plain PDF) and an HSM attestation extract (meta page) — Ben will pull the attestation materials.
- For rotation logs we will produce a sampling CSV that follows our export schema and redact tenant ids; we will include column headers and 10 anonymized rows as an example.
- For BYOK wrap/unwrap flow we will provide a short diagram and the operator/approval steps (MFA + dual-control) as text.

Ben / Marissa — can you confirm owners for each artifact and whether we should use the shared drive link below to stage the docs? I think target delivery Tue May 11 is doable.

Link to tracking sheet: https://drive.redwood.com/s/cedarcloud-evidence/handbook
Attachment: request_tracker.csv (internal tracker stub)

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ethan Rogers <ethan@cedarcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CedarCloud SIG/CAIQ: request for key custody + rotation samples

Ethan / Neha —

Attached are the initial artifacts we discussed: a PDF extract of our HSM attestation (meta page only) and a truncated rotation log sample CSV. Notes below.

Attachment stubs:
- redwood_hsm_attestation_2026-12.pdf (attestation meta page; cert chain fingerprint present; no private telemetry)
- rotation_log_sample_truncated.csv (10 rows, headers)

What we sent:
- HSM attestation: this is the vendor-signed attestation issued Dec 2026 for the cluster(s) that host hosted tenants. It includes model numbers, firmware version, and attestation timestamp. We redacted serials that are tied to our internal inventory.
- Rotation CSV schema: columns = [event_time_utc, key_id_hash, tenant_scope, operator_email, event_type, reason, rotation_ticket]. In the sample we replaced tenant ids with a stable pseudonym (tenant_xxx) and rotation_ticket is a reference id in our ticketing system (safe to share).

Clarifications re: BYOK / wrap flow (short):
- BYOK flow: customer provides KEK material; we accept via customer-managed KMS endpoint or upload into our HSM where it is immediately wrapped under a cluster-wide KEK. The wrapped key blob is stored; unwrapping requires operator dual-control + KMS audit approval.
- Ephemeral tenant keys: per-tenant ephemeral keys used for session encryption are generated in-memory and are not written to persistent keystores; we maintain a TTL and rotate them on eviction.

Next steps:
- If you need raw logs (unredacted) for audit under an NDA we can arrange a controlled transfer.
- Otherwise, we'll stage the full CAIQ/SIG artifact bundle (narrative, attestation, redaction checklist, sample logs) to the shared drive by EOD Tue May 11.

Ben Carter
Senior Ops Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Ethan Rogers <ethan@cedarcloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CedarCloud SIG/CAIQ: request for key custody + rotation samples

Ben / Neha — thanks, this is very helpful. A couple of quick clarifications before we close the loop: 

1) For the BYOK wrap/unwrap: when you say "wrapped under a cluster-wide KEK" can you confirm whether the cluster KEK is rotated on a schedule and whether that rotation re-wraps stored BYOK blobs (i.e., is there a re-wrap procedure)? If yes, can you provide the change-log event type we should look for in the rotation CSV?

2) For the rotation CSV we received: can you confirm the anonymization approach (stable pseudonym vs full hash) — we prefer a deterministic pseudonym so we can follow an object through multiple rows without being able to resolve the original tenant id.

If those are trivial yes/no answers we can mark items resolved; otherwise we may schedule a 20-min call. Also we need confirmation that the attestation meta page includes firmware and SEAL versions (we saw it but want to be explicit for our vendor risk team).

If it's easier, can you push the full bundle to the shared drive and flag a single file named CEDAR_EVIDENCE_READY.txt? We'll treat that as the handoff trigger for our SIG owner.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Ethan Rogers
Security Manager — CedarCloud
security@cedarcloud.com
